criteria.text: With PDD_MAX_JOBS unset, all 7 selected checks reach the server before any check finishes, without a local-slot wait.
With PDD_MAX_JOBS=2, at most 2 jobs run at once, including jobs from two local processes sharing the same state folder and runtime host.
An invalid PDD_MAX_JOBS value prints one warning line per command and imposes no cap.
A confirmed busy refusal honors Retry-After and existing minimum waits, retries only the unstarted check with a new request ID, reduces the check dispatch window to 1 and never replays accepted work.
With no cap, remote lint and Try setup proceed past existing active leases and older waiting tickets without a local-slot wait; request records, ownership and uncertain-job evidence remain intact.

With no cap, dead or stale owners leave no safely reclaimable tickets or leases behind; fresh live owners and recent uncertain job evidence stay protected, without network probes or admission waiting.
All uploads of one packed source share one immutable source Blob, keeping identical source bytes and distinct request IDs without a default job cap.
With 20 selected checks, at most 8 source POSTs await replies by default, or 2 with PDD_MAX_UPLOADS=2; all 20 are sent, and an answered POST frees a place while accepted jobs still run.
An invalid PDD_MAX_UPLOADS warns once and uses 8; the upload setting is per process and never limits GET reads or server jobs.

cases.given: 7 selected checks; no environment cap; terminal replies held
cases.required_observation: All 7 unique check POSTs arrive before any terminal reply, no local-slot notice, durable request IDs match active records.

cases.given: Two actual CLI processes, three selected checks each, one shared state directory, PDD_MAX_JOBS=2
cases.required_observation: Peak active jobs is 2; more checks wait until released, all 6 complete once.

cases.given: Repeat seven-before-completion with PDD_MAX_JOBS=0; also empty, -1, 1.5, text, whitespace, leading zero and unsafe integer
cases.required_observation: One warning line per command, no cap or local-slot wait.

cases.given: Explicit cap2, accepted first check held, second check confirmed busy with Retry-After7; later selected check held
cases.required_observation: No third check or busy retry while first remains accepted; wait >=10s; replacement has new ID, accepted scenario sent once; saved refusal retained.

cases.given: No cap; seed four fresh active uncertain leases and an older waiting ticket; run explicit lint and Try setup
cases.required_observation: Both modes POST without local waiting or foreign record mutation; each new request registered before dispatch.

cases.given: Omitted/Infinity limit; older live waiting ticket and active leases; register duplicate IDs then release uncertain/ended
cases.required_observation: Immediate active reservation without sleep/probe/status; ordered deduplicated IDs and private files; foreign evidence preserved.

cases.given: Omitted/Infinity limit with already expired deadline or interruption; separately stop at immediate active record creation in explicit lint
cases.required_observation: Return null before file effects when already stopped; stop after active creation registers no request and makes no POST, removes own unsent reservation, preserves foreign uncertain evidence.

cases.given: No cap; three selected checks; first accepted stays running, two peers confirmed busy with Retry-After 7
cases.required_observation: All three initial POSTs occur, no busy retry while accepted work runs, exit 3 at caller deadline; accepted ID is never replayed.

cases.given: No cap; expired waiting/unsent/30-minute leases, fresh live old lease, recent dead uncertain lease; changed snapshot or heartbeat during cleanup
cases.required_observation: Only safely reclaimable unchanged expired records disappear; no sleep, runtime probe or waiting line. Preserve changed/refreshed records and recent uncertain evidence; contention cannot delay admission.

cases.given: Seven selected checks and preliminary lint upload the same packed source; fetch and multipart source boundary observed
cases.required_observation: All multipart bodies reuse one source Blob, source.tar bytes/type stay exact and request IDs remain distinct, within the independent per-process upload setting.

cases.given: 20 selected checks; hold first 8 POST replies (2 for explicit2), then release one reply as queued while GET terminal replies remain gated
cases.required_observation: No POST above the upload setting before a reply; next POST starts after one reply while accepted work still runs; release remaining gates and all20 finish exactly once.

cases.given: Repeat 20-check gated POST scenario with PDD_MAX_UPLOADS=0; separately empty, negative, fraction, whitespace, text and unsafe integer; leading-zero positive decimal is valid
cases.required_observation: Invalid value warns once and permits at most8 unanswered POSTs; GETs proceed independently; all20 sent once.
